changeSet.author: snapdragon
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO games (id, name, description, slug, sort_order, created_at) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM games), 'Chess (Godot)', 'Two-player chess rendered in Godot. Reuses the SAME deterministic Rust rules engine as the web-native chess (via the ChessEngine GDExtension bridge) — host-authoritative, the guest re-validates every move. The reference for the Godot game architecture.', 'chess-godot', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM games), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games WHERE slug = 'chess-godot');

changeSet.author: snapdragon
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO chapters (name, description, slug, scene_type, sort_order, asset_url, scene_config, game_id, created_at) SELECT 'Chessboard (Godot)', 'Standard 8x8 chess in a Godot WASM bundle. White and black join one session; the host ChessEngine (Rust core) is authoritative and the guest re-validates every move.', 'chess-godot', 'chess', 1, '/_remotes/wasm-fragment/chess-godot/index.html', '{}', (SELECT id FROM games WHERE slug = 'chess-godot'), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters WHERE slug = 'chess-godot');

changeSet.author: snapdragon
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO federation_modules (slug, display_name, kind, remote_entry_url, exposed_module, game_slug, version, enabled, metadata) VALUES ('games-chess-godot', 'Chess (Godot)', 'wasm-game', '/_remotes/wasm-fragment/chess-godot/index.html', NULL, 'chess-godot', '0.1.0', true, '{"sse":true,"hostAuthoritative":true,"engine":"godot","core":"snapdragon-chess"}'::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (slug) DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: snapdragon
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO game_access (game_id, scope, scope_value, granted_by, granted_at) SELECT g.id, 'all', NULL, 'system:migration-053', NOW() FROM games g WHERE g.slug = 'chess-godot' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM game_access ga WHERE ga.game_id = g.id AND ga.scope = 'all' AND ga.scope_value IS NULL );
